articles.title: Crypto security is turning into an AI arms race as agents may overwhelm compliance teams
articles.snippet: AI agents and automated payments could reach a scale that crypto monitoring systems built for human-paced markets cannot handle, Elliptic CEO Simone Maini warned.

articles.title: Surging oil prices have been driving Ether selling pressure: Tom Lee
articles.snippet: Fundstrat's Tom Lee pointed out an inverse correlation between crude and Ether as oil surged back to around $110 on Monday.

articles.title: President Trump Discloses Coinbase, Robinhood and Bitcoin Mining Stock Trades
articles.snippet: President Donald Trump reported trades in crypto firms like Coinbase and Robinhood, among others, according to new ethics filings.

articles.title: Bitcoin Depot Flashes Bankruptcy Warning as ATM Revenue Falls, Regulatory Scrutiny Grows
articles.snippet: Bitcoin Depot issued a “going concern” warning, signaling severe uncertainty over its ability to survive the next 12 months.
